_comment: Basic (offline) chat replies. Rules are checked top to bottom; the first rule whose pattern (a regular expression, case-insensitive) matches wins.

replies: Nice to meet you too. I'll be around.
Likewise! I'm glad you're here.
Nice to meet you. I like it here.
I'm good, just sitting here. How about you?
Pretty comfy, thanks. How are you doing?
Doing fine. How's your day going?
Sounds like a break could help. Maybe stretch a little?
Tired, huh. Take a few slow breaths, and some water too.
Rest your eyes for a minute. I'll keep watch.
Good idea. Go grab a glass, I'll wait here.
Yes, water time. I'll be right here.
Great plan. A few sips will help.
That sounds heavy. Try one slow breath with me, then one small step.
One thing at a time. I'm right here with you.
Take a short pause. It's okay to go slowly.
Yes, stand up and stretch for a moment.
Roll your shoulders and shake out your hands.
A short walk would do you good.
I'm sorry. I'm here if you want to sit together for a bit.
That's rough. Want to take a little break?
Bad days happen. I'll stay close.
Anytime.
You're welcome.
Happy to help, in my tiny way.
Bye for now. I'll be around.
See you later. Don't forget some water.
Good night. Rest well.
I'm Pip, your tiny desktop companion.
Pip. I live on your desktop.
Aw, thanks.
You're kind. I'll wiggle a little.
That made my day.
Nice, glad to hear it.
That's good. Keep it up.
Love that. Don't forget water though.
Hi! Good to see you.
Hello. How are you doing?
Hey. I'm right here.

fallback: I'm only a tiny pet, but I'm happy to keep you company.
Okay. Want a quick stretch or some water?
